services.desc: At the helm of Big Delicious Catering’s culinary experience is Owner and Executive Chef, Hunter Smith. He loves creating custom experiences for guests that far exceed any expectations. Those who have the chance to enjoy Hunter’s cuisine will undoubtedly taste his passion for food. With an eclectic background in everything from Japanese to French techniques, he uses fresh ingredients to make unique culinary concepts come to life. You might have seen him on the hit TV Show “Iron Chef America” with acclaimed Vail restaurateur Kelly Liken.
